description: Project-owned measurement asking whether a selected clue is legible at first exposure without requiring a genre-specific implementation module.
instructions: At this presentation checkpoint, how legible is the selected clue from the performed material alone?

criteria.legible: A first-exposure reader can identify the clue as potentially meaningful.
criteria.ambiguous: The detail is perceptible but its possible significance is genuinely ambiguous.
criteria.obscured: The detail is unlikely to register as a clue from the supplied performed material.
